newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front - May 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on May 15:
MOSCOW - Russia and NATO reached agreement on a document outlining a new political and military relationship that will allow the alliance to expand to the borders of the former Soviet Union.
BERLIN - The terms of the security partnership reached between Russia and NATO portend the most dramatic upheaval in the 48-year history of the world's most successful military alliance.
WASHINGTON - Eagerly anticipated research released Wednesday indicate that two recently discovered "breast cancer" genes play a less important role in cancer than scientists had presumed.
LAREDO, Tex. - Drug and illegal immigrant cases are piling up as federal judgeships remain vacant and courts are inundated.

ORANGE, Calif. - Of all the sad and seamy tales to emerge from the sex scandal at the Army training base in Aberdeen, Md., the story told by Pvt. Angela Thomas perhaps best dramatizes the severe erosion of military discipline there and its consequences.

WASHINGTON - Prince George's County leaders tried to quell public anxiety about the quality and condition of the county's schools by approving a plan to ease classroom crowding and launching a campaign to rebuild confidence in the schools' academic performance.
